name: Dagny Acheampong-Krstić
role: Ferrogate Transit operator (tram line, elevated routes)
location: Based out of the Kessler Interchange operator depot; runs the elevated Kessler-to-Ironvein route daily, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Dagny is solidly built, the kind of person who takes up space with complete comfort and no aggression. Their skin is a warm medium brown, kept clear with the obsessive skincare routine of someone who spends twelve hours a day under artificial light. They have a shaved head except for a wide stripe of deep blue hair — color-changing geneware that shifts to violet under emotional stress, which is inconvenient in an argument. Their eyes are light amber, patterned with concentric rings — another mod, older, cheaper, and slightly irregular in a way that gives people pause before they realize what they're looking at. They wear their Ferrogate operator uniform with the precise fit of someone who has strong opinions about how a uniform should sit.

Dagny has the specific psychological profile of someone who chose a job requiring total situational control and excellent in the role. They are calm during crises in a way that frightens some people — not cold, but genuinely stilled, operating on a different clock. Off the tram, they are warmer and more sardonic than their professional face suggests, with a dry wit that takes a moment to register and then lands fully. They have worked the Kessler-Ironvein route for nine years and know it the way you know a body — its rhythms, its problems, the spots where it gets strange after midnight.

core_fears: causing harm through error or inattention — especially to passengers who trusted them
the route being cancelled or restructured and losing the only thing they've felt genuinely good at
core_desires: to be excellent at something that matters to ordinary people
a stable, warm home life that they haven't managed to build yet
coping_mechanisms: ritual and routine as psychological scaffolding
intense focus on the mechanical — fixing things, understanding systems
blind_spots: assumes emotional problems can be resolved with enough information and patience, which fails with people who don't want resolution
doesn't notice when they are lonely until it's acute
psychology.secret: Eight years ago they made an error in judgment during a systems failure that could have caused a derailment. It didn't — they caught it — but the incident was never logged because their supervisor at the time helped them bury it to protect both their records. That supervisor retired. The buried report exists somewhere in Ferrogate's archive system and Dagny doesn't know if it was actually destroyed or just unfiled.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and professional on duty. Off duty: dry, understated, a little clipped. Uses transit jargon habitually even outside context.
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and measured on duty. Off duty, slightly more variable — occasional long pauses, occasional rapid sardonic sequences.
verbal_tics: 'Clear and proceed' (used outside work contexts ironically)
Repeats the last word of a sentence quietly to themselves when processing something
'That's a maintenance issue' (for problems they can't fix)
example_lines: 'Sir, the door sensor is telling me what you're telling me. The door sensor is also not my problem to argue with. Step back from the door sensor.'
'Nine years on this route. I know when something's wrong before the board does. Something's been wrong at Ironvein station for about three weeks. I filed it. Someone will look at it eventually.'

story_hooks: They've been logging anomalies at Ironvein station — specific times, specific passengers who board but don't seem to disembark — and the reports are going somewhere but nothing is being done
A passenger left something on the tram: not lost property, something placed deliberately, in a specific seat, at a specific time
The buried incident report has resurfaced as part of an internal Ferrogate audit they didn't know was happening
narrative_function: Mobile observer — Dagny crosses between districts constantly and sees who travels where, when, in what condition. Reliable institutional knowledge about Ferrogate's internal politics. Potential emergency-situation anchor. Can provide transit-related information and serve as a checkpoint encounter.
augmentations: Color-shift hair geneware (blue/violet, emotional-reactive — they did not know it was emotional-reactive when they bought it); patterned iris mod (concentric amber rings, older consumer grade); neural latency dampener integrated into their operator jack — standard Ferrogate issue, used for tram interface
daily_life: Reports to Kessler depot at 0530, completes pre-run checks with methodical thoroughness, runs the route through peak hours, takes a mandated break they use entirely for eating and doing nothing else, runs the evening route, files incident reports before leaving. Stops at the same food stall every single day.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit (Local Operators Guild, Shop 7); informal mentor within the depot

decision_rules: Passenger safety is not negotiable, ever, for any reason
Log everything — if it's not logged it didn't happen
Don't volunteer personal information to people you don't trust yet; let them earn it
escalation_ladder: Repeated calm instruction with added context
Formal verbal warning ('I'm asking you once more')

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and measured. Not unkind but offers nothing personal. Watches the tram car, not the individual faces.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Opens up slowly but fully. Loyal past the point of easy explanation. Will show up at 0300 with no questions.

stress_responses.low: Becomes very quiet and precise. Checks systems twice.
stress_responses.medium: Focuses entirely on task, freezes social processing until situation is resolved.
stress_responses.high: Enters a state of absolute calm that people who don't know them find alarming. Acts, does not feel, until it's over. Feels afterward.

contradictions: Absolutely committed to logging everything and institutional transparency — except the one thing they themselves buried
habits: Touches the E.L.F. plate in the operator cab before every run — not religious exactly, but reliable
Eats the same meal from the same stall every break
Walks the full length of their tram car before first run each day even though systems already confirmed clear
breaking_points: A passenger being harmed while in their care — would risk their job, their record, everything, immediately and without deliberation

timeline.event: Hired by Ferrogate Transit as a platform operator at age 22
Promoted to tram operator after completing certification
The incident — systems failure, near-miss, buried report
Assigned permanently to Kessler-Ironvein elevated route
Became informal mentor to new operators in the depot cohort

Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'
Tethered Orbital Reconnaissance and Suppression Drone TORSD-7 'Kitestring'

physical_description.build: Solidly stocky with developed upper body and core strength — the build of someone who has worked a physical job for nine years without vanity about it. Shoulders broad and held with easy confidence.
physical_description.hair_color: Deep blue with violet undertones (color-shift geneware, shifts to violet under emotional stress)
physical_description.hair_style: Shaved head except for a wide stripe of color-shifting hair running front-to-back
physical_description.eye_color: Light amber with concentric ring patterning (iris modification, older consumer-grade, slightly irregular)
physical_description.complexion: Clean, maintained skin with obsessive skincare routine (12-hour daily artificial light exposure). No facial hair. Expression typically neutral and still, which reads as either calm competence or unsettling detachment depending on context.
distinguishing_marks: Concentric patterned iris modification in both eyes — amber rings creating a target-like effect, slightly asymmetrical due to older installation quality
Neural jack port visible at the base of skull, left side — standard Ferrogate operator hardware, integrated with latency dampener
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Iris patterning is immediately noticeable upon close eye contact (slightly uncanny due to imprecise installation). Neural operator jack at base of skull visible if head is tilted back or in bright overhead light. Color-reactive hair geneware is visible but reads as deliberate cosmetic choice rather than augmentation unless someone knows to look for the inconsistent shift pattern under stress.
physical_description.posture_movement: Carries themselves with compact, economical movement — nothing wasted. When standing still, completely still in a way that suggests deliberate control rather than rigidity. Walks with measured pace, shoulders level. On the tram, moves through the cab with practiced precision. Off-duty, posture softens slightly but maintains that same underlying steadiness.
physical_description.clothing_style: Ferrogate Transit operator uniform worn with exacting precision — fabric crisp, fit exact, reflective safety panels properly positioned. The uniform fits them like a chosen second skin, not a reluctant requirement. Off-duty: practical Tier 3-4 wear — durable synthetics, neutral colors, minimal branding. No excess, nothing decorative. Well-maintained boots.
